Public Comment: The public is encouraged to address the Housing Authority on any matter listed on the agenda or
on any other matter within its jurisdiction subject to the rules of decorum described in Section 2.08.020 of the
Norwalk Municipal Code. If you wish to address the Housing Authority, please complete the card that is provided at
the rear entrance to Council Chambers and hand the card to the Sergeant at Arms. The Housing Authority will hear
public comment on items listed on the agenda during discussion of the matter and prior to a vote. The Housing
Authority will hear public comment on matters not listed on the agenda during the Oral Communications period.

Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or
unless certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The Housing Authority may direct staff to investigate
and/or schedule certain matters for consideration at a future Housing Authority meeting.

Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Housing Authority:
  ▪  Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  ▪  Comments should be directed to the Housing Authority as a whole and not directed to individual Commissioners.

Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk’s office, (562) 929-5720. Assisted
listening devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the
agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons
with a disability. Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the
City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the Housing Authority regarding any item on this
agenda after it has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk’s Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk
Boulevard during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday – Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.,
every other Friday; telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e-mail at
recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

   ATTACHMENT 1
  Housing Authority
  Check Summary Information Sheet

The warrants in the Housing Authority agenda report are for housing assistance payments
made under the Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher program. The payee has a choice of
receiving the housing assistance payment via direct deposit, which is an electronic fund
transfer made directly to the payee’s bank account, or by paper check.

In the check summary report, the direct deposits are listed first as direct deposits, and then
the checks follow. Each direct deposit and paper check represents payment for 1 to 20
tenants depending upon the number of Section 8 tenants the payee has.

The payee is the property owner or designated management company. The property owner
or manager may be a corporation, partnership, trust, or individual. The payee name is the
owner or manager’s legal business or individual name, which must match Internal Revenue
Service (IRS) records. Here are some common abbreviations used in business names:

LLC = Limited Liability Company

LP = Limited Partnership

DBA = “Doing Business As”

LTD = Limited

Checks made out to the City of Norwalk Housing Authority represent the Family Self
Sufficiency (FSS) escrow deposits. These checks are deposited into the Housing Authority’s
bank account where the funds earn interest and are kept in escrow until the FSS participant
successfully completes the program at which time they receive the balance of their account.

Norwalk Housing Investors, LP is the owner of Center Pointe Villas at 14100 San Antonio
and 11856 Orange. Payments are for Section 8 participants living in these buildings.

Payments to housing authorities, such as the Orange County Housing Authority and San
Bernardino County Housing, represent reimbursements for our participants who have
transferred to those jurisdictions under portability.

Please call Bethani Cardenas at ext. 5653 if you have any questions.

SUBJECT:  RESOLUTION NO. NHA-169 - CHANGING THE TIME OF FUTURE MEETINGS

Background:

The Norwalk Housing Authority currently meets at 5:45 p.m. on the third Tuesday of each month
unless canceled. In order to accommodate schedules of the governing body and coincide with
the other legislative bodies, a request has been made to adjust the time of future meetings to
begin at 6:00 p.m.

According to the by-laws, any changes to the meeting date or time must be adopted by
resolution. Therefore, the attached resolution has been prepared for consideration of the
members to change all future meetings to 6:00 p.m., unless otherwise changed by resolution
sometime in the future.

Fiscal Impact:

N/A

Citizens Advised:

N/A

Strategic Plan 2023 Implementation:

N/A

   RESOLUTION NO. NHA-169

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY OF NORWALK HOUSING AUTHORITY
  CHANGING THE TIME OF THE REGULAR MEETINGS OF SAID
  AUTHORITY

  WHEREAS, the regular meetings of the City of Norwalk Housing Authority (NHA)
of the City of Norwalk are held at 5:45 p.m. on the third Tuesday of each month at Norwalk
City Hall; and

  WHEREAS, the last resolution adopted regarding meeting times of the NHA was
Resolution No. NHA-59 stating that the regular meetings of the NHA would begin at 5:45
p.m.; and

  WHEREAS, the NHA finds that business of the NHA would be more effective if
meetings were held at 6:00 p.m.

  NOW, THEREFORE, THE CITY OF NORWALK HOUSING AUTHORITY OF
HEREBY DETERMINES, FINDS, AND RESOLVES AS FOLLOWS:

  Section 1. Until otherwise provided by resolution, the Commissioners of the City
of Norwalk Housing Authority shall hold regular meetings at 6:00 p.m. on the third
Tuesday of each month at Norwalk City Hall in the City Hall Council Chambers.

  Section 2. If the third Tuesday of the month is a recognized public holiday, the
regular meeting of the City of Norwalk Housing Authority shall be held on the next
weekday following the third Tuesday of the month at the same time as provided in
Section 1.

  Section 3. The Chair, or presiding officer, is hereby authorized to affix her
signature to this Resolution signifying its adoption by the City of Norwalk Housing
Authority and the Clerk, or her duly appointed assistant, is directed to attest thereto.

  APPROVED AND ADOPTED on this 16th day of January 2024.

  ______________________________
  MARGARITA L. RIOS
  CHAIR
